info.title: SweetCommerce Customer and Merchant API
info.description: Review candidate reconciled against signed BRD R2 plus DEC-020 and DEC-021. Commercial provider setup and unresolved policy remain separately gated.

Set-Cookie.description: Secure HttpOnly opaque same-origin session cookie
Secure HttpOnly opaque same-origin session cookie

post.description: Verify an unused admin-only challenge against the current enrolled destination and epoch. RECOVERY atomically revokes prior sessions and invalidates earlier admin challenges. This never provisions an account.

Role-bound challenge for the enrolled admin contact only. RECOVERY is optional, default SIGN_IN. If no enrolled channel is available, use restricted manual owner verification; no public contact-reset or enrollment endpoint.

Cancel an owned, unpaid and unaccepted order only before transfer. Recorded proof, receipts or unresolved transfer evidence block cancellation. A customer who sent or may have sent a transfer uses the external merchant WhatsApp contact instead.

requestBody.description: At most 5 MiB. Complete validated registration, rather than upload start, adjudicates the deadline.

post.description: Register standard top-up proof before the current 30-minute cutoff to keep capacity through review. Timely event balance proof before the effective grace cutoff (or effective due time if there is no separate grace) protects the slot through review. Late evidence enters merchant reconciliation and cannot reopen an order, booking or allocation. Event supplement evidence uses the current deposit or effective balance cutoff. A supplement request never restarts it.

Treat the Idempotency-Key as the durable submission-intent ID for this account. Persist the request digest and intent on the event. Replay returns the original event or a conflict for changed payload, even after short-lived command receipt expiry while the event is retained.

Cancel an owned application or quote free of charge before the first transfer, including after quote acceptance while awaiting deposit. Recorded proof, receipts or unresolved transfer evidence block cancellation. A sent or paid balance never entitles the customer to cancellation or a refund.

put.description: Saves ordered photo IDs in the same versioned write as catalogue fields. The first attached ID is the cover. Detached photos stop serving to customers; staged or foreign product IDs cannot be attached except valid staged media for this product.

Confirm the reviewed edit with its impact token. A change to date revision, affected order membership or state (including unallocated Cash or fee requests), or the edit requires a fresh preview. Closure preserves accepted orders. Caps below occupied or used quantities are refused.

post.description: Merchant may counteroffer a viable handoff and fee before rejection. Serviceable offers require both values. Persist the exact offered terms and revision independently of the accepted promise.

Driver arrival is a distinct delivery fact. Incidents can be recorded before or after handoff. MERCHANT_UNABLE cancellation records the full remaining verified-receipts refund obligation under the same lock; manual payout uses a refund intent.

totalMinor.description: At least two MYR sen. Deposit rounds half up to a whole sen, and the balance is the positive remainder.

post.description: Reject totals below two sen before any quote or reservation write. Derive two positive instalments using the whole-sen split.

noBalanceFundsReceived.description: Merchant attests they checked actual bank receipts and found no funds for the original balance.

post.description: CUSTOMER_REQUEST is eligible only before transfer with confirmed non-transfer and no conflicting payment evidence. MERCHANT_UNABLE includes Proceeding before fulfilment is complete and creates full remaining verified-receipts refund obligations. BALANCE_OVERDUE requires the current effective cutoff to have passed, no timely balance proof under review, no recorded or disputed balance funds, and a bank-check attestation that no balance funds were received. Release unused resources only on authorized cancellation and preserve audit history.

NORMAL matches the exact expected balance. SUPPLEMENT binds the open mismatch case and posts one independently verified top-up. Only an exact combined total on an eligible, feasible order may accept. After the top-up cutoff, acceptance requires proof registered before the current deadline even if expiry work has not run. RECONCILIATION records actual funds without reopening. For late event deposit verification under DEC-021 include lateDepositDecision; server checks deadline and records the effective 24-hour window or reschedule/refund case. For EVENT_DEPOSIT or EVENT_BALANCE, SUPPLEMENT binds the current mismatch case and records an independently verified movement once. The existing deposit or effective balance cutoff governs. Timely evidence can be reviewed after cutoff. Only an exact verified net total on an eligible charge advances its event. Late, excess, or unresolved shortfalls follow manual reconciliation without automatic booking or deadline reset. If exact deposit settlement is reached after the original balance due time, DEC-021 still applies.

Reject evidence without treating it as proof of no transfer. REQUEST_SUPPLEMENT applies to a verified shortfall with an active standard allocation. It issues the top-up notice and fixes a deadline 30 minutes after issuance, without resetting an active deadline on retry. A timely top-up proof keeps the hold through review; expiry with no timely proof releases unused capacity and leaves funds in reconciliation. REJECT_STANDARD_ORDER and REJECT_EVENT_DEPOSIT release unused capacity or window respectively, with verified receipts handled separately. For EVENT_DEPOSIT or EVENT_BALANCE, REQUEST_SUPPLEMENT instead requires a verified shortfall before the applicable existing cutoff. It publishes the amount owed and that cutoff without opening a timer. An unresolved shortfall at or after cutoff follows manual reconciliation.
Confirm an independently verified payout against the matching reserved refund intent. Use the actual movement reference and current charge version.

get.description: MYT dates: standard counts by acceptedAt, event counts by first verified booking confirmation, production by service date, receipts/refunds by actual movement. Count each application with an issued quote in the selected window once; verified deposit updates its cohort once. Standard orderStatus filters only counts and prep, not financial totals.

post.description: Lock review; return the existing order if submitted, otherwise prevent every future submission of this review before a new intent may start.
Mark uncertain without releasing funds, or void only after verifying the payout did not occur. Confirmed payout uses recordRefund against this same intent.
Agreement must cover the revised promise. Use same allocation transaction to preserve original commitment if the change fails.
Create a separately tracked DuitNow charge only after recorded customer agreement to the fee. The accepted original order total remains unchanged.
Admin only. Validate at most 5 MiB, file signature and decode; normalize or reject. Stage candidate for the specified product without changing its saved gallery.

get.description: Admin-only scoped staging/gallery preview. No proof objects served here.
Customer session required. Serve only current attached media of a listed product. Unlisted, sold-out, unattached or unknown media returns non-disclosing 404.

post.description: Preview scoped impacted orders for proposed closure or cap change. Token binds proposed date, version and normalized edit. No order or allocation mutations.

get.description: Read active shop handoff calendar defaults and fixed approved cutoffs.

put.description: Change weekly handoff availability for new commitments only. Keep existing promises; shop remains open for online requests.

get.description: Requires a customer session. Read the current listed product with eligible variants and ordered photo IDs. Hidden or missing items return a safe 404.

dueAt.description: Consented MYT time on the new local event date minus three calendar days. It must be strictly in the future at commit.

post.description: Bind consent to the revised schedule and balance plan. Keep settled balance paid. For an outstanding balance, require the agreed due instant on the new local event date minus three days, strictly in the future at commit, and grace ending exactly 24 hours after due. Swap unused resources and write a new deadline revision and replacement notice atomically. An invalid window or OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED leaves the existing case and commitments intact for another date or refund.

get.summary: Get merchant notice attempts and follow-up

outstandingMinor.description: Expected amount minus verified unapplied/refundable-adjusted receipts, clamped to zero. Server applies eligible settlement guards separately.

requiredRefundMinor.description: Unfulfilled portion of a merchant-inability full-refund obligation, derived per verified receipt.

topUp.description: The current standard-order top-up request. Null when no active request exists.

message.example: Review the current total and handoff before submitting.

ConfirmNoTransfer.description: Explicit confirmation that the customer has not sent a payment. This does not override recorded or disputed evidence.
